headline: Mercedes-Benz unveils new point-to-point driving assist
summary: Mercedes-Benz is launching MB.Drive Assist Pro, a point-to-point driving assist system coming to the US and Germany in 2027 to compete with Tesla's FSD.

claims.statement: Mercedes-Benz's new MB.Drive Assist Pro system is a step toward self-driving.

sources.quote: Benz takes us another step towards self-driving.

claims.statement: The system includes a point-to-point driver assist that handles complex traffic.

sources.quote: Mercedes' clever new driving assist handles complex traffic like a champ

claims.statement: The point-to-point driver assist is coming to the US and Germany in 2027.

sources.quote: The point-to-point driver assist is coming to the US and Germany in 2027.

claims.statement: The launch includes two features, hands-free highway driving and point-to-point city navigation, competing with Tesla's FSD.

sources.quote: the launch of two new features next year: hands-free highway driving and a point-to-point city navigation system
